title: Ep 15 — OpenAI locks its own staff out of your prompts, and the AI clone that hit six figures before it launched
description: OpenAI previews a privacy layer that flags misuse without staff reading your prompts, Cursor lets its coding agents run whole goals unsupervised, and Google, Replit and Amazon all ship new AI features. Plus a deep dive on Jodie Cook's AI-clone coaching platform Coachvox AI, which reportedly hit six figures in revenue before launch, and fresh urban EV-charging hub openings from IONITY and RAW Charging that validate the EV-Partnerships destination-charging thesis.
